description: This file contains unit tests for the LeavePeriodHistoryService in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies the correct generation and retrieval of leave periods, including handling different start dates, leap years, and date ranges.
external_files: Other dependencies like Config, TestDataService, KernelTestCase are part of the core testing framework and project libraries.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistoryServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for LeavePeriodHistoryService, verifying leave period generation based on historical start dates, handling leap years, and date range calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating the LeavePeriodService instance and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDateIsNotSet
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown when the date parameter is null in getGeneratedLeavePeriodList.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests leave period generation with a start date of January 1st, 2010, and verifies the output includes subsequent years.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1st
methods.description: Tests leave period generation with a start date of January 1st, 2010, similar to above but with different internal fixture.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListForLeapYear
methods.description: Tests leave period generation over a leap year period, but is marked as skipped (xtest) likely due to date constraints.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1stAnd2012Jan1st
methods.description: Verifies multiple historical start dates and the corresponding generated leave periods.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListCase1
methods.description: Test case generating leave periods with different start months and days, skipped (xtest) possibly due to testing constraints.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Checks retrieval of current leave period given specific dates, ensuring correct period ranges are returned.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodArrayToYmdArray
methods.description: Helper method to convert an array of LeavePeriod objects to an array of YMD date strings.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodToArray
methods.description: Converts a LeavePeriod object to an array with start and end date strings.
